'''''Lancer I''''' was a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] that saw service with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. The vessel was assigned to [[Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209/Legends|Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209]].<ref name="BlackIce">[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref>
